w:r.w:t: client web portal is available. User is signed out.
Open the AgriX sign-in page. Review the login form, password controls, account links, header, and footer. Exercise the visible controls and check their feedback and navigation.

Confirm the sign-in page loads without errors; the form and controls are visible, readable, and keyboard accessible; validation and feedback are clear; and navigation links open their intended destinations.
The Sign In form appears with Email Address and Password fields, a Show control, Remember me checkbox, Forgot Password link, and Sign in button.
Submit the form with both fields empty.
The form prevents submission and clearly identifies the required fields.
Enter an invalid email format and a password, then submit.
The email field shows a clear validation message and the form does not submit.
Enter a validly formatted email and an incorrect password, then submit.
Sign-in is rejected and an understandable error message appears without exposing sensitive account details.
Enter a password and click Show. Click it again to hide the password.
The password becomes readable while shown and is masked again when hidden; the control remains usable.
Toggle Remember me off and on.
The checkbox state changes when selected and can be returned to its previous state.
The password recovery page or flow opens and explains how to request a reset link.
Enter valid credentials for an active account and click Sign in.
The user is authenticated and taken to the intended post-login page.
Use the keyboard to move through the form and submit with Enter.
Focus follows a logical order, controls have visible focus, and Enter submits the form when appropriate.
The browser returns to the AgriX home page.
Click the moon icon in the header.
The theme changes and all form text, links, fields, and controls remain readable.
Review the footer links and social icons, then resize the browser to a narrower width.
Footer items remain readable and usable; the sign-in form and header adapt to the narrower viewport without clipping or horizontal overflow.
Click the AgriX logo in the header.
The browser returns to the AgriX home page.
